quotes.name: Tangleroot
quotes.flavor: As if there's glitch in the system, the Tangle sometimes folds in on itself, throwing off sparks of mana in a mystifying display.

quotes.name: Savage Lands
quotes.flavor: Jund is a world as cruel as those who call it home. Their brutal struggles scar the land even as it carves them in its image, a vicious circle spiraling out of control.

quotes.name: Murder
quotes.flavor: Ob Nixilis decided the fastest way to seize control of New Capenna would be to usurp the networks of power already hidden there. Xander's Maestros were the first to fall.

quotes.name: Pistus Strike
quotes.flavor:
"Even a nuisance such as the pistus fly has a purpose in our new world."
—Glissa

quotes.name: Impervious Greatwurm
quotes.flavor: The ultimate answer to intrigue and subtlety.

quotes.name: Hellcat, Undying Vigilante
quotes.flavor: "Throw me at anything—I'll always land on my feet."

quotes.name: Blasphemous Act
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor:
"Holy places are no longer sanctuary from death, and death is no longer sanctuary from anything."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

quotes.name: Tranquil Expanse
quotes.flavor: Despite the chaos of the Roil and the devastation of the Eldrazi, Zendikar is a world of breathtaking beauty.

quotes.name: Whisperer of the Wilds
quotes.flavor: She speaks only in whispers but can be heard over the fiercest storm.

quotes.name: Myr Landshaper
quotes.flavor: One thing the myr can't do is enjoy the scenery.

quotes.name: Plaguecrafter
quotes.flavor: "My power is generosity, in a way. I give my survivors an appreciation for their lives."

quotes.name: Riveteers Ascendancy
quotes.flavor: "We are this city, down to its bones."

quotes.name: Grave Pact
quotes.flavor:
"The bonds of loyalty can tie one to the grave."
—Crovax, ascendant evincar

quotes.name: Ozai, the Phoenix King
quotes.flavor: "Out of the ashes, a new world will be born."

quotes.name: Esika, God of the Tree // The Prismatic Bridge
quotes.flavor: The beginning of the rainbow.

quotes.name: Pack Rat
quotes.flavor: Rats carry disease—it's why they get such sick pulls.

quotes.name: Elfhame Palace
quotes.flavor: The elfhames are the closest thing to "civilization" the elves allow themselves.

quotes.name: Fact or Fiction
quotes.flavor: Two futures unfurled before the mage, each rife with its own promise.

quotes.name: Squee, Goblin Nabob
quotes.flavor:
"Some goblins are expendable. Some are impossible to get rid of. But he's both—at the same time!"
—Starke

quotes.name: Magus of the Will
quotes.flavor: "These eyes have shown me the flaws of flesh."

quotes.name: Raise Dead
quotes.flavor: The earth cannot hold that which magic commands.

quotes.name: Gerrard's Verdict
quotes.flavor: A heart of light and a soul of darkness cannot coexist.

quotes.name: Furnace Whelp
quotes.flavor: Baby dragons can't figure out humans—if they didn't want to be killed, why were they made of meat and treasure?

quotes.name: Vineglimmer Snarl
quotes.flavor: A verdant paradox of primal logic.

quotes.name: Esika, God of the Tree // The Prismatic Bridge
quotes.flavor: The end of us all.

quotes.name: Anaconda
quotes.flavor: You'll never find an anaconda in a swamp. It will always find you first.

quotes.name: Cackling Imp
quotes.flavor: Its laughter drives needles through your mind.

quotes.name: Titanic Growth
quotes.flavor: The massive dominate through might. The tiny survive with guile. Beware the tiny who become massive.

quotes.name: Llanowar Elves
quotes.flavor: As patient and generous as life, as harsh and merciless as nature.

quotes.name: Sky Weaver
quotes.flavor: "Let my wisdom give you wings."

quotes.name: Sun Titan
quotes.flavor: A blazing sun that never sets.

quotes.name: Timberwatch Elf
quotes.flavor: "If you ever want to leave this forest, now's the time."

quotes.name: Soul Warden
quotes.flavor: "One does not question the size or shape of the grains of sand in an hourglass. Nor do I question the temperament of the souls under my guidance."

quotes.name: All Is Dust
quotes.flavor:
"The emergence of the Eldrazi isn't necessarily a bad thing, as long as you've already lived a fulfilling and complete life without regrets."
—Javad Nasrin, Ondu relic hunter

quotes.name: Owen Grady, Raptor Trainer
quotes.flavor: "I don't control the raptors. It's a relationship. It's based on mutual respect."

quotes.name: Steely Resolve
quotes.flavor: No one in Wirewood understands what is happening. They just know it's unnatural—and coming from Krosa.

quotes.name: Worldly Counsel
quotes.flavor: Every horizon hides a new possibility.

quotes.name: Righteousness
quotes.flavor:
"I too shall be brought low by death, but until then let me win glory."
—Homer, *Iliad, Book XVIII*

quotes.name: Cirith Ungol Patrol
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"Spies feared on Stairs. Double vigilance. Patrol to head of Stairs."
—Shagrat's orders

quotes.name: Azusa, Lost but Seeking
quotes.flavor: "I do not miss Jukai Forest. It is not my home. My home is Kamigawa, its people my family. Wherever I set my pack and rest my head, I am home."

quotes.name: Farrel's Zealot
quotes.flavor: After the fall of Trokair, Farrel and his followers formally broke their ties with the rest of Icatia.

quotes.name: Nine-Lives Familiar
quotes.flavor: Her master gathered the bones to resurrect her, only to find her purring on the altar.

quotes.name: Tempted by the Oriq
quotes.flavor: To exact his vengeance, Extus needed followers. His infiltrators recruited promising mage-students from the very halls he sought to destroy.

quotes.name: Firestorm Hellkite
quotes.flavor:
"If it can scar the sky with fire, do not share its destination."
—Mwani, Mtenda herder

quotes.name: Curio Vendor
quotes.flavor: "Step right up! Try your hand! It'll thrill the senses and boggle the mind!"

quotes.name: Assassin's Trophy
quotes.flavor:
"A merry life and a short one, as promised. How well I know myself."
—Bartholomew "Black Bart" Roberts

quotes.name: Sunken Hope
quotes.flavor: While Dominarians fought for their world, Rath stole it from under their feet.

quotes.name: Giant Spider
quotes.flavor: While it possesses potent venom, the Giant Spider often chooses not to paralyze its victims. Perhaps the creature enjoys the gentle rocking motion caused by its captives' struggles to escape its web.

quotes.name: Tariel, Reckoner of Souls
quotes.flavor:
"After death you face paradise, damnation, or Tariel."
—Priest's teaching

quotes.name: Inexorable Tide
quotes.flavor: Radiation is an invisible tide that seeps into the bones of the land, changing it irrevocably.

quotes.name: Brilliant Spectrum
quotes.flavor: There are more sights on Zendikar than the eyes can see.

quotes.name: Kraken's Eye
quotes.flavor: Bright as a mirror, dark as the sea.

quotes.name: Mind Stone
quotes.flavor:
"What is mana but possibility, an idea not yet given form?"
—Jhoira, master artificer

quotes.name: Maelstrom Pulse
quotes.flavor: During the collision of the shards, entire ways of life disappeared without a trace.

quotes.name: Isolate
quotes.flavor: Threefold were his crimes, doubled were his pleas, singular was his fate.

quotes.name: Blacksmith's Skill
quotes.flavor: Before he was subjugated by demonic forces, Dakkon was a master smith of unrivaled artistry.

quotes.name: Progenitus
quotes.flavor: The Soul of the World has returned.

quotes.name: Generous Gift
quotes.flavor: The best presents are impossible to regift.

quotes.name: Weaver of Blossoms // Blossom-Clad Werewolf
quotes.flavor: Living in harmony with nature . . .

quotes.name: Reclamation Sage
quotes.flavor: "What was once formed by masons, shaped by smiths, or given life by mages, I will return to the embrace of the earth."

quotes.name: Tropical Island
quotes.flavor: 2019 Europe Legacy Champion

quotes.name: Ainok Bond-Kin
quotes.flavor: "Hold the line, for family and the fallen!"

quotes.name: Urza's Power Plant
quotes.flavor: Artifact construction required immense resources.

quotes.name: Soul Conduit
quotes.flavor:
"You have an unhealthy attachment to your selfhood. I can help you with that."
—Malcator, Executor of Synthesis

quotes.name: Frenzied Goblin
quotes.flavor: The upside to not thinking about the consequences is that you'll always surprise those who do.

quotes.name: Vedalken Orrery
quotes.flavor: The model incorporated the fifth sun effortlessly, as if it had always known.

quotes.name: Waker of Waves
quotes.flavor: On the open sea, there is nowhere to hide.

quotes.name: Brass's Bounty
quotes.flavor:
"Why squabble for trinkets when we could be living large off all this gold?"
—Admiral Beckett Brass

quotes.name: Rogue's Passage
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

quotes.name: Kiln Walker
quotes.flavor: If it possesses an ability to understand and appreciate life, it has never shown it.

quotes.name: Contract Killing
quotes.flavor: For a price, the floating city of High and Dry offers all the amenities a pirate could want: rest, recreation, and revenge.

quotes.name: Marhault Elsdragon
quotes.flavor: Marhault follows a strict philosophy, never letting emotions cloud his thoughts. No chance observer could imagine the rage in his heart.

quotes.name: Magma Jet
quotes.flavor: Some Akroans make the dangerous pilgrimage to the volcanic temples of Purphoros, where oracles known as flamespeakers glean omens from lava.

quotes.name: Goblin Medics
quotes.flavor:
"First, do some harm."
—Oath of Goblins

quotes.name: Armored Pegasus
quotes.flavor: Asked how it survived a run-in with a bog imp, the pegasus just shook its mane and burped.

quotes.name: Gnarled Professor
quotes.flavor: "Class is in season."

quotes.name: Reave Soul
quotes.flavor:
"I was not convinced you had a soul until I saw it for myself."
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: True Believer
quotes.flavor: So great is his certainty that mere facts cannot shake it.

quotes.name: Ghost Warden
quotes.flavor:
"I thought of fate as an iron lattice, intricate but rigidly unchangeable. That was until some force bent fate's bars to spare my life."
—Ilromov, traveling storyteller

quotes.name: Scorching Spear
quotes.flavor: Lift your spear as you might lift your glass, and toast your enemy.

quotes.name: Stiltstrider
quotes.flavor: Impossibly tall, improbably elegant.

quotes.name: Civic Guildmage
quotes.flavor:
To condemn the innocent you must first condemn yourself.
—Civic Guild maxim

quotes.name: Winds of Rath
quotes.flavor:
"There shall be a vast shout and then a vaster silence."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

quotes.name: Colossus of Sardia
quotes.flavor: Buried under a thin layer of dirt, it was known for centuries as Mount Sardia.

quotes.name: Skittering Invasion
quotes.flavor:
"The brood spread far faster than we could kill it. I fear the worst is yet to come."
—*The War Diaries*

quotes.name: Stone Giant
quotes.flavor: What goes up, must come down.

quotes.name: Shamanic Revelation
quotes.flavor: First, whispers of ancient days. Then, visions of things to come.

quotes.name: Scroll of Fate
quotes.flavor:
"Our stories define our reality."
—Ugin

quotes.name: Urborg Uprising
quotes.flavor: In Urborg, few things are less permanent than death.

quotes.name: Kokusho, the Evening Star
quotes.flavor: The fall of the evening star never heralds a gentle dawn.

quotes.name: Jace's Archivist
quotes.flavor: "This is a sacred duty. Master Beleren's trust has bought an eternity of my loyalty."

quotes.name: Unmoored Ego
quotes.flavor: A well-chosen word can restore a mind or snap its tethers.

quotes.name: Kirol, Attentive First-Year
quotes.flavor: Kirol hated being a pawn in Morcant's game. If dawnglove was as potent as she suggested, it should be preserved, not used to tip the balance of power.

quotes.name: Firedrinker Satyr
quotes.flavor: Attending a satyr revel requires a high tolerance for pain.

quotes.name: Loose Lips
quotes.flavor: Your sentence can't be longer than this one.

quotes.name: Unholy Strength
quotes.flavor: "I don't *feel* any different."

quotes.name: Living Wish
quotes.flavor: He wished for growth, but not for a way to control it.

quotes.name: Shimmerdrift Vale
quotes.flavor: Reflections from the wind-sculpted snow gleam with every color of the rainbow.

quotes.name: Sewer Rats
quotes.flavor:
You lie down with rats, and the rats run away.
—Suq'Ata insult

quotes.name: Furor of the Bitten
quotes.flavor: Those who only believe themselves infected with lycanthropy can be as dangerous as those who really are.

quotes.name: Lingering Tormentor
quotes.flavor: The bogeyman doesn't disappear when you close your eyes.

quotes.name: Lure
quotes.flavor: Her true theft was to steal the soldiers away from their posts.

quotes.name: Wall of Water
quotes.flavor: A deafening roar arose as the fury of an enormous vertical river supplanted our serenity. Eddies turned into whirling geysers, leveling everything in their path.

quotes.name: Whipflare
quotes.flavor: The slag-workers wasted no time in creating their own flare pulses to cleanse the area of the *incompleat*.

quotes.name: Brush Off
quotes.flavor: "You're the one who brought a priceless scroll to a duel!"

quotes.name: Bloodforged Battle-Axe
quotes.flavor: With just his trusty axe, Grognak became king.

quotes.name: Telling Time
quotes.flavor: Time moves strangely in Duskmourn. The terrors of the past snap at the heels of an unknowable future, while the torments of the present stretch into infinity.

quotes.name: Intrepid Tenderfoot
quotes.flavor: Narix felt their molt coming. Before taking a new form, they had to find what Evendo required of them.

quotes.name: Voidslime
quotes.flavor: Slimy Service at Saloon Sends Scamp Scrambling

quotes.name: Wanderwine Hub
quotes.flavor: Below the great river, a bustling hub channels the flow of merrow trade.

quotes.name: Slaughter the Strong
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: It was a big day for the gravediggers at Cliffside Cemetery.

quotes.name: Alluring Suitor // Deadly Dancer
quotes.flavor: "May I have this dance?"

quotes.name: Hoverguard Observer
quotes.flavor: It could be made to run silently, but its low hum reminds the Neurok that they are always watched.

quotes.name: Angelic Quartermaster
quotes.flavor: "Stand strong. We will reclaim the dawn."

quotes.name: Stab
quotes.flavor: Elgin's final mistake was assuming an intruder would come through the door, and not up the sheer, smooth, six-story wall.

quotes.name: Frost Walker
quotes.flavor:
"As the clans carved out their territories, we saw allies where the Mardu saw only obstacles."
—Yasova Dragonclaw

quotes.name: Wall of Spears
quotes.flavor:
"A stick is your friend. A pointed stick is your good friend. An army of pointed sticks is your best friend."
—Onean sergeant

quotes.name: Minotaur Aggressor
quotes.flavor: The smelting district is home to many who see the guilds as not for them.

quotes.name: Ancient Carp
quotes.flavor:
"Why eat now what could one day grow into a feast?"
—Ojutai, translated from Draconic

quotes.name: Tentative Connection
quotes.flavor: Lukka was ordered to kill a threat. He chose to make a friend.

quotes.name: Temple Garden
quotes.flavor: The kithkin was admiring the flowers when the skies darkened, then they ripped up the roots for the next season.

quotes.name: Tonic Peddler
quotes.flavor: "The price is written at the bottom of the cup."

quotes.name: Baithook Angler // Hook-Haunt Drifter
quotes.flavor: Geor was determined to stay out until he got a bite from something big.

quotes.name: Martial Glory
quotes.flavor:
"Yes, Boros tactics are unparalleled. But when your comrades are dying around you, inner strength must carry the day."
—Gideon Jura, to Aurelia

quotes.name: Dreadbore
quotes.flavor: In Rakdos-controlled neighborhoods, everyone is part of the show.

quotes.name: Alesha, Who Smiles at Death
quotes.flavor: "Greet death with sword in hand."

quotes.name: Magma Spray
quotes.flavor:
"Jund is a wounded world. Beware its searing blood spilling out onto the surface."
—Rakka Mar

quotes.name: Cut a Deal
quotes.flavor: The beauty of Valley is born from the differences between animalfolk, not despite them.

quotes.name: Famished Ghoul
quotes.flavor: Memories have distinct tastes. Its favorites are the sickly sweetness of lost love and the bitter smokiness of cruel murder.

quotes.name: Liliana's Contract
quotes.flavor: She sold her soul to four demons for powerful gifts.

quotes.name: Key to the City
quotes.flavor: It would be unfortunate if the key fell into the wrong hands.

quotes.name: Obyra, Dreaming Duelist
quotes.flavor: Obyra sleepwalks through the wilds, hunting for worthy opponents.

quotes.name: Bulwark Giant
quotes.flavor:
"Where did she come from? More importantly, are there more like her?"
—Gideon Jura

quotes.name: Dimir Signet
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor: An emblem of a secret guild, the Dimir insignia is seen only by its own members—and the doomed.

quotes.name: Flawless Maneuver
quotes.flavor:
"Captain, your units are the tip of our spear. There is zero room for failure."
—Jirina Kudro

quotes.name: Marsh Flats
quotes.flavor:
"We remember all the world has endured, everything it has gone through to bring us to today. We are proud of Tarkir."
—Betor

quotes.name: Presence of Gond
quotes.flavor: "Here lies Gond, hero of Safehold Taldwen. May he ever guide our quest."

quotes.name: Gorilla War Cry
quotes.flavor:
"The only 'art' these beasts possess is the art of noise!"
—Jaya Ballard

quotes.name: Jamie McCrimmon
quotes.flavor: "Creag an tuire!"

quotes.name: Zenos yae Galvus // Shinryu, Transcendent Rival
quotes.flavor: "The heavens are too small a field for our dance. Let us transcend this mortal coil!"

quotes.name: White Dragon
quotes.flavor: White dragons are unparalleled hunters, keenly focused on slaughtering their enemies.

quotes.name: Crime Novelist
quotes.flavor: "But then he peeled off the mask, revealing a sight that made Groja's blood run cold—Brulu was actually Vogos in disguise!"

quotes.name: Drag to the Underworld
quotes.flavor: The more you struggle against death, the tighter its grip becomes.

quotes.name: Blighted Fen
quotes.flavor:
"We came to a place where the skin of Zendikar was peeled back and its bones lay bare to the sky."
—Greenweaver Mina

quotes.name: Iridescent Hornbeetle
quotes.flavor: The hatchlings will fill the jungles of Murasa in a glittering tide.

quotes.name: Cloudblazer
quotes.flavor: All the aether charts in the world can't compete with the trained eye of a talented scout.

quotes.name: Fecundity
quotes.flavor: Life is eternal. A lifetime is ephemeral.

quotes.name: Locust Spray
quotes.flavor:
「鎧の質は継ぎ目次第。」
――「虚栄の迷路：騎士の愚行」

quotes.name: Flare of Fortitude
quotes.flavor: "I call upon a power greater than myself."

quotes.name: Hate Mirage
quotes.flavor: A trick of the light, though momentary, can still be deadly.

quotes.name: Quiet Speculation
quotes.flavor:
"The best foresight is hindsight."
—Empress Llawan

quotes.name: Young Blue Dragon // Sand Augury
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: "I see the far side of tomorrow and the lost memories of queens. What do you wish to learn?"

quotes.name: Frost Giant
quotes.flavor: The Frost Giants have been out in the cold a long, long time, but they have their rage to keep them warm.

quotes.name: Llanowar Elves
quotes.flavor: As patient and generous as life, as harsh and merciless as nature.

quotes.name: Don & Leo, Problem Solvers
quotes.flavor: Technician. Tactician.

quotes.name: Fountain of Renewal
quotes.flavor: Entrepreneurs have attempted to sell the water, but to no avail. Whatever magic it contains disappears upon bottling.

quotes.name: Yasharn, Implacable Earth
quotes.flavor: In its hoofprints, barren dust becomes fertile ground.

quotes.name: Chieftain en-Dal
quotes.flavor: The clearest commands are practical examples.

quotes.name: Bison Whistle
quotes.flavor:
"I knew a bison whistle would come in handy."
—Aang

quotes.name: War Cadence
quotes.flavor: The rhythm isn't a call to arms, but a signal that the goblins have made a new enemy.

quotes.name: Royal Assassin
quotes.flavor: Trained in the arts of stealth, royal assassins choose their victims carefully, relying on timing and precision rather than brute force.

quotes.name: Shadow of the Enemy
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: As Frodo put on the Ring, Sauron was suddenly aware of the magnitude of his own folly. His wrath blazed in consuming flame, but his fear rose like black smoke.

quotes.name: Barbarian Riftcutter
quotes.flavor:
"Riftcutters are suicidal anarchists, waving those lightning axes around so much that the walls are as likely to fall as their foes."
—Heruj, Selesnya initiate

quotes.name: Demonic Bargain
quotes.flavor:
"Do not try to negotiate with me, human. You want power? This is the price."
—Ormendahl

quotes.name: Mana Reflection
quotes.flavor: The greatest wonders of nature are found in the smallest saplings straining toward the canopy.

quotes.name: Prosperous Innkeeper
quotes.flavor: "I'll give you a free flagon of ale if you don't talk to me about the weather."

quotes.name: Boomerang
quotes.flavor: "O! call back yesterday, bid time return." —William Shakespeare, *King Richard the Second*

quotes.name: Consider
quotes.flavor: Ivold gasped in surprise. Either a very strange insect had crawled onto one of the lenses or he was seeing geists at last!

quotes.name: Angelic Protector
quotes.flavor:
"My family sheltered in her light, the dark was content to wait."
—Crovax

quotes.name: Fetid Heath
quotes.flavor:
"Do not linger in such places, child. There the gwyllions dance. If they find you, you will join in their revels for eternity."
—Talara, elvish safewright

quotes.name: Fallow Earth
quotes.flavor:
". . . and when the farmer awoke the next morning, all the seeds from his field were once again in their sacks."
—Afari, *Tales*

quotes.name: Word of Seizing
quotes.flavor: "Obey!"

quotes.name: Arni Brokenbrow
quotes.flavor: "I headbutted a troll. And won."

quotes.name: Bastion of Remembrance
quotes.flavor: Lives taken are lives not easily forgotten.

quotes.name: Fog Elemental
quotes.flavor:
"It's the perfect sentry. Those who should pass can go right through it."
—Teferi

quotes.name: Golgari Germination
quotes.flavor: The Golgari don't bury their dead. They plant them.

quotes.name: Duress
quotes.flavor: "Change your mind, or I'll change it for you."

quotes.name: Yue, the Moon Spirit
quotes.flavor: "You'll save the world again. But you can't give up."

quotes.name: Viscera Seer
quotes.flavor: In matters of life and death, he trusts his gut.

quotes.name: Tomb of the Spirit Dragon
quotes.flavor:
"The voice calls me here, yet I see only bones. Is this more dragon trickery?"
—Sarkhan Vol

quotes.name: Whitemane Lion
quotes.flavor: Saltfield nomads call a sudden storm a "whitemane."

quotes.name: Addle
quotes.flavor:
"I'll wring out your tiny mind like a sponge."
—Urborg witch

quotes.name: They Went This Way
quotes.flavor:
"Running doesn't prove guilt, but innocent people don't typically flee into the North Ridge Forest."
—Alst of the Foundway Associates

quotes.name: Ambush Wolf
quotes.flavor: It lies perfectly still and silent for hours, concealed in the undergrowth, until its prey draws close enough to strike.

quotes.name: Silent Sentinel
quotes.flavor: It serves a justice higher than the whims of the gods.

quotes.name: Rakdos Signet
quotes.flavor: Made of bone and boiled in blood, a Rakdos signet is not considered finished until it has been used as a murder weapon.

quotes.name: Goblin Hero
quotes.flavor: They attacked in an orgy of rage and madness, but only one seemed as focused on killing us as on the sheer joy of battle.

quotes.name: Ketria Triome
quotes.flavor: Nowhere on Ikoria are monsters more integral to the landscape than Ketria, where the river itself will stand up and roar.

quotes.name: Gloomwidow
quotes.flavor: The abandoned towns on the moors didn't stay empty for long.

quotes.name: The Stasis Coffin
quotes.flavor: Tawnos built it to be absolutely impermeable to any force inside. Luckily it worked for any force outside as well.

quotes.name: Colossal Majesty
quotes.flavor:
"Might doesn't just build empires. It protects them."
—Inti, Sun Empire knight

quotes.name: Raise Dead
quotes.flavor: The earth cannot hold that which magic commands.

quotes.name: Flusterstorm
quotes.flavor:
"We sing of the night the sky fell and the hero who held the vault of heaven aloft."
—*Legend of the Nomad Sage*

quotes.name: Aya of Alexandria
quotes.flavor: ". . . and our blades shall never tire."

quotes.name: Syphon Mind
quotes.flavor: When tempers run high, it's easy to lose your head.

quotes.name: Al-abara's Carpet
quotes.flavor: Al-abara simply laughed and lifted one finger, and the carpet carried her high out of our reach.

quotes.name: Centaur Courser
quotes.flavor:
"The centaurs are truly free. Never will they be tamed by temptation or controlled by fear. They live in total harmony, a feat not yet achieved by our kind."
—Ramal, sage of Westgate

quotes.name: Boromir, Warden of the Tower
quotes.flavor: "Farewell, Aragorn! Go to Minas Tirith and save my people!"

quotes.name: Worship
quotes.flavor:
"Believe in the ideal, not the idol."
—Serra

quotes.name: Vampire Aristocrat
quotes.flavor: "I admit, I am a creature of the city. The sights, the nightly excitement, the abundance of fine drink . . ."

quotes.name: Lodestone Golem
quotes.flavor:
"Somehow it warps the Æther. It brings a strange weight, a blockade in the flow of spellcraft."
—Noyan Dar, Tazeem lullmage

quotes.name: Grimclaw Bats
quotes.flavor: Even on a world of metal, there are those who thirst for blood.

quotes.name: Ravenous Daggertooth
quotes.flavor: A daggertooth's triumphant roar makes all the sounds of jungle life fall silent.

quotes.name: Loam Lion
quotes.flavor: In Zendikar, today's grassland could be tomorrow's jungle, and hunting grounds change as quickly as the weather.

quotes.name: Brago, King Eternal
quotes.flavor: "My rule persists beyond death itself."

quotes.name: Imperious Perfect
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Elves vs. Goblins
quotes.flavor: In a culture of beauty, the most beautiful are worshipped as gods.

quotes.name: Volcanic Hammer
quotes.flavor: Fire finds its form in the heat of the forge.

quotes.name: Wall of Distortion
quotes.flavor: It reflects only nightmares.

quotes.name: Divine Verdict
quotes.flavor: Cunning warriors and dim-witted beasts alike fall under the church's harsh judgment.

quotes.name: Dreamstone Hedron
quotes.flavor: Only the Eldrazi mind thinks in the warped paths required to open the hedrons and tap the power within.

quotes.name: Karfell Kennel-Master
quotes.flavor: Trapped in a realm of dead flesh and scarce hunting, the ravenous wolves of Karfell follow the Dread Marn to warm game.

quotes.name: Gimli's Fury
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: "Two!" said Gimli, patting his axe.

quotes.name: Lethal Sting
quotes.flavor: Initiates once believed defeat was the worst fate possible—a sentiment they quickly abandoned.

quotes.name: Call the Skybreaker
quotes.flavor: It hears and answers every orison across Shadowmoor.

quotes.name: Aether Storm
quotes.flavor:
"I do love the rain . . . but this storm feels somehow wrong, Taysir."
—Daria

quotes.name: No Witnesses
quotes.flavor: When cunning fails, there's always violence.

quotes.name: Elvish Archers
quotes.flavor: I tell you, there was so many arrows flying about you couldn't hardly see the sun. So I says to young Angus, "Well, at least now we're fighting in the shade!"

quotes.name: La Forge, Perceptive Engineer
quotes.flavor: "Captain, the sensor sweep is fine, but my VISOR is picking up some disturbing fluctuations in the dilithium crystal matrix."

quotes.name: Rampaging Baloths
quotes.flavor:
"When the land is angry, so are they."
—Nissa Revane

quotes.name: Yasharn, Implacable Earth
quotes.flavor: In its hoofprints, barren dust becomes fertile ground.

quotes.name: Leonardo, Worldly Warrior
quotes.flavor: "Push yourself beyond your limits, to a place where there are no limits!"

quotes.name: Tamanoa
quotes.flavor: When Freyalise spoke the World Spell, the tamanoa rose to bring a new morning to Terisiare.

quotes.name: Rot-Tide Gargantua
quotes.flavor: Now that it doesn't need to breathe, its hunting ground extends well beyond the sea.

quotes.name: Reprieve
quotes.flavor:
「苦しみもがく人に憐みをもって手を差し出すのは、この世界の一員が果たすべき当然の務めなのです。」
――シルバークイルの学部長、マルジョー

quotes.name: Hungry Flames
quotes.flavor: In the hold of the *Heart of Kiran*, Chandra answered Dovin Baan's sabotage with an explosive retort.

quotes.name: Dragon Whelp
quotes.flavor: "O to be a dragon . . . of silkworm size or immense . . ." —Marianne Moore, "O to Be a Dragon"

quotes.name: Heartflame Duelist // Heartflame Slash
quotes.flavor: "The fire of Embereth will never be doused!"

quotes.name: Time Sieve
quotes.flavor: . . . trade the whole world for one more moment . . .

quotes.name: Sustainer of the Realm
quotes.flavor: You may break her shield, but you'll never break her spirit.

quotes.name: Stormkeld Vanguard // Bear Down
quotes.flavor: He rides like thunder and strikes like lightning.

quotes.name: Army of Allah
quotes.flavor: On the day of victory no one is tired. —Arab proverb

quotes.name: Drowned Catacomb
quotes.flavor: None can tell how many vessels are tangled up on the sea floor—or how much treasure remains unclaimed.

quotes.name: Plague Rats
quotes.flavor:
"Should you a Rat to madness tease
Why ev'n a Rat may plague you..."
—Samuel Coleridge, "Recantation"

quotes.name: Masterwork of Ingenuity
quotes.flavor:
"The crucible yields what you have forged in your mind. You need only reach in and draw the masterwork forth."
—Wahara, Keeper of the Crucible

quotes.name: Darkwater Catacombs
quotes.flavor: Murky Otarian tides hide the forgotten treacheries of the Phyrexian war.

quotes.name: Urborg Phantom
quotes.flavor: A chilling fog with teeth of ice.

quotes.name: Third Path Iconoclast
quotes.flavor: "When all you have is a hammer, everything looks like a nail. I merely propose expanding our toolbox."

quotes.name: Reave Soul
quotes.flavor:
"Into amethyst, I pour
Envy's shadow, sorrow's gleam.
Lure the one whose scorn I bore
That I may hear one final scream."
—Barrow witch incantation

quotes.name: Magefire Wings
quotes.flavor: Giving a thing wings does not take away its fear of flight—or its fear of fire, for that matter.

quotes.name: Goreclaw, Terror of Qal Sisma
quotes.flavor: You don't want to know how she got that name.

quotes.name: Ghired, Mirror of the Wilds
quotes.flavor: "The Conclave was soft. The Clans were trapped beasts. Here in this untamed wilderness, nature can truly roam free."

quotes.name: Lifecrafter's Gift
quotes.flavor: The best engineers recognize when a problem has already been solved.

quotes.name: Phyrexian Hulk
quotes.flavor:
It doesn't think. It doesn't feel.
It doesn't laugh or cry.
All it does from dusk till dawn
Is make the soldiers die.
—Onean children's rhyme

quotes.name: Valley Questcaller
quotes.flavor: No battle is fought, or won, alone.

quotes.name: Hunter of Eyeblights
quotes.flavor: Snokk ran as fast as he could, but the sound of hooves grew ever louder in his ears.

quotes.name: Dalek Drone
quotes.flavor: "Elevate."

quotes.name: Pongify
quotes.flavor:
「我々はここに、原理原則とはなんたるかの模範を目撃する。どんなものだろうと"壊す"ことなどありえない。それは壊滅的なまでに再構成されるだけなのだ。」
――ラクサ教授

quotes.name: Artful Dodge
quotes.flavor: Those who know the alleys and sewers of the Erdwal can disappear like smoke.

quotes.name: Temper
quotes.flavor:
"I don't need a plan, just a goal. The rest will follow on its own."
—Gerrard

quotes.name: Goldnight Commander
quotes.flavor: "One faith, but many hands in victory."

quotes.name: Electrodominance
quotes.flavor: "Basically, we turn a bunch of little lightnings into one big lightning."

quotes.name: Display of Power
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"The Nazgûl closed round at night, and I was besieged. Such light and flame cannot have been seen on Weathertop since the war-beacons of old."
—Gandalf

quotes.name: Cloudstone Curio
quotes.flavor: It *wants* to remain a mystery, banishing the curious in favor of less inquisitive company.

quotes.name: Death Pit Offering
quotes.flavor:
"Kill them all and feed them to the new recruits."
—Crovax, ascendant evincar

quotes.name: Vile Manifestation
quotes.flavor: The glyphs writhed and twisted, spewing out dark, vengeful magic.

quotes.name: Fading Hope
quotes.flavor: "At least I won't become one of . . . those things."

quotes.name: Harmonize
quotes.flavor:
"Animals commune with their environment without the need for language. Theirs is a fundamental connection that surpasses flimsy words."
—Vivien Reid

quotes.name: Skullclamp
quotes.flavor: The mind is a beautiful bounty encased in an annoying bone container.

quotes.name: Seismic Assault
quotes.flavor: The flowstone seemed for a moment to assume Greven's rage—it lunged like a wild beast at the *Weatherlight*.

quotes.name: Millikin
quotes.flavor: The toymaker frowned in bewilderment. None of his creations had ever sneezed before.

quotes.name: Essence Scatter
quotes.flavor:
"Venturing beyond campus means learning how to deal with creatures not bound by university rules."
—Emil, Vastlands roamer

quotes.name: Mortify
quotes.flavor: Many who cross Sorin's path come down with a sudden and fatal case of being-in-the-way-of-a-millennia-old-vampire.

quotes.name: Goblin Warrens
quotes.flavor:
"Goblins bred underground, their numbers hidden from the enemy until it was too late."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. IV*

quotes.name: Dinrova Horror
quotes.flavor:
"Welcome to the Dimir Public Offices. Not responsible for death or loss of property. Basement off-limits."
—Sign outside Dinrova Building

quotes.name: Gnarlback Rhino
quotes.flavor:
"I think it's trying to tell us that the forest is angry."
—Vivien Reid

quotes.name: Homing Lightning
quotes.flavor:
"I see countless worlds. What makes them think I can't find them in just one?"
—Ral Zarek

quotes.name: Obelisk of Grixis
quotes.flavor: Like most features of Grixis, the obelisks that remain from the time of Alara now exist only for dark exploitation.

quotes.name: Wurm's Tooth
quotes.flavor: A wurm knows nothing of deception. If it opens its mouth, it plans to eat you.

quotes.name: Poison-Tip Archer
quotes.flavor: "One more step and you're mine."

quotes.name: Canopy Vista
quotes.flavor:
"Apalapucia, voted number two planet in the top ten greatest destinations for the discerning intergalactic traveler."
—The Eleventh Doctor

quotes.name: Imaginary Threats
quotes.flavor: Liliana always knew Jace's illusions would come in handy.

quotes.name: Sire of Stagnation
quotes.flavor: As the great scourge passed by, Zendikar shivered, then lay silent.

quotes.name: Feral Invocation
quotes.flavor: Nylea's sacred lynx guards those who honor the Nessian Wood and hunts those who don't.

quotes.name: Archmage Emeritus
quotes.flavor: Some emeritus professors return from their wanderings periodically to share tales of the mystical wonders of Arcavios.

quotes.name: Tainted Well
quotes.flavor:
"No, *you* get the water. I ain't thirsty."
—Squee

quotes.name: Galestrike
quotes.flavor: Strong wings make strong winds.

quotes.name: Lose Calm
quotes.flavor: A lifetime of discipline forsaken in a moment of rage.

quotes.name: Wayfarer's Bauble
quotes.flavor: Druids hold certain plants to be sacred and use their leaves and wood as a spellcasting focus.

quotes.name: TVA Bureaucrat
quotes.flavor:
"Time is chaos. We supply order."
—Mobius M. Mobius

quotes.name: Infuse
quotes.flavor:
"The potential for change lies in all things. Know a thing's nature, know its possibilities, and know it anew."
—Gustha Ebbasdotter, Kjeldoran Royal Mage

quotes.name: Lightning Blow
quotes.flavor:
"If you do it right, they'll never know what hit them."
—General Jarkeld, the Arctic Fox

quotes.name: Mighty Leap
quotes.flavor: "I feel the presence of the God-Pharaoh in the Second Sun, and I rise upon its rays."

quotes.name: T'Chaka, Venerable King
quotes.flavor: "I am king of Wakanda. A line unbroken. A crown unconquered."

quotes.name: Omenspeaker
quotes.flavor: Her prophecies amaze her even as she speaks them.

quotes.name: Mirkwood Meditator
quotes.flavor: Elves always knew what was going on among the peoples of the land—as quick as water flows, or quicker.

quotes.name: Crystalline Sliver
quotes.flavor: Bred as living shields, these slivers have proven unruly—they know they cannot be caught.

quotes.name: Harrow
quotes.flavor: Changing Rath's landscape is like tearing the scab from a wound.

quotes.name: Dreadmaw's Ire
quotes.flavor:
"That's the fifth ship lost in three days! Can't we build them out of something stronger?"
—Malcolm Lee

quotes.name: Zada, Hedron Grinder
quotes.flavor: To her delight, she was able to fully realize the explosive magical potential of hedrons.

quotes.name: Okina Nightwatch
quotes.flavor: Only the most skilled budoka could protect the Okina Shrine. Only the best of these protectors took the night watch.

quotes.name: Brass's Bounty
quotes.flavor:
"Why squabble for trinkets when we could be living large off all this gold?"
—Admiral Beckett Brass

quotes.name: Ancient Ziggurat
quotes.flavor: Built in honor of Alara's creatures, the ziggurat vanished long ago. When Progenitus awakened, the temple emerged again.

quotes.name: Dosan the Falling Leaf
quotes.flavor:
"Each night as Master Dosan prays to the kami, the hate he receives in return withers his body a little more. Though the kami are slowly killing him, still he continues his prayers."
—Meditation journal of a young budoka

quotes.name: Serra Angel
quotes.flavor: Follow the light. In its absence, follow her.

quotes.name: Umara Entangler
quotes.flavor: "Sea Gate is gone, the Halimar basin empty. But rebuild the seawall and give these waters time, and they will fill the basin anew."

quotes.name: Isleback Spawn
quotes.flavor: Cuanto más mortal es el monstruo del lago, más corto es el cuento.

quotes.name: Think Twice
quotes.flavor:
"Great books are meant to be read, then read again backwards or upside down!"
—Ettovard, Tolarian archivist

quotes.name: Blossoming Sands
quotes.flavor: The Alacrian Quickbeasts desire not only to win, but to forge new alliances against the unknown threats of this interconnected Multiverse.

quotes.name: Azorius Signet
quotes.flavor: The maze-like design embodies the core of Azorius law—strict structure designed to test wills and stall change.

quotes.name: Grazing Gladehart
quotes.flavor:
"Don't be fooled. If it were as docile as it looks, it would've died off long ago."
—Yon Basrel, Oran-Rief survivalist

quotes.name: Talisman of Conviction
quotes.flavor:
"The sun banishes darkness every morning. I too will rise with such assuredness."
—Huatli

quotes.name: Vines of the Recluse
quotes.flavor: "The most elegant solutions are found in nature. You just have to know where to look."

quotes.name: Razortide Bridge
quotes.flavor: In order to join the Order of the Tadpole, one must pass an athletics test that requires participants to run along the bridge, contending with feral ghouls, bloodbugs, and the bridge's dilapidated state. Don't forget to stretch!

quotes.name: Temple of the False God
quotes.flavor:
"When gods become apathetic, the people will worship anyone who answers their pleas."
—Kiora

quotes.name: Macetail Hystrodon
quotes.flavor: The goblins tracked the hystrodon with much stealth and cunning. Then they were eaten with much pain and yelling.

quotes.name: The Reaver Cleaver
quotes.flavor:
"Time for a Knuckles sandwich!"
—Knuckles the Echidna

quotes.name: Mogg Alarm
quotes.flavor: They make mountains into mogg holes.

quotes.name: Jungle Hollow
quotes.flavor: On the surface of Ixalan's vast tar pits, Phyrexian oil glistened, and old bones began to stir.

quotes.name: Dwarven Weaponsmith
quotes.flavor: "Work with zeal as hammers peal! Melt, anneal, and pound the steel!" —Old Dwarvish forge-chant

quotes.name: Wickerbough Elder
quotes.flavor: "Living scarecrows make a mockery of the natural order. Dead ones make fine hats."

quotes.name: Sacred Mesa
quotes.flavor:
"Do not go there, do not go / unless you rise on wings, unless you walk on hooves."
—"Song to the Sun," Femeref song

quotes.name: Shadowheart, Dark Justiciar
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: "Shar's will shall be done. As sure as night will fall."

quotes.name: Daraja Griffin
quotes.flavor:
"And the flamingos said, 'Get out of our nest—we can't be seen with the likes of you!' So, the griffin ate them."
—Azeworai, "The Ugly Bird"

quotes.name: Irrigated Farmland
quotes.flavor:
"Biodome Tunnel is out of bounds. Andy and Tarak are infected."
—Captain Adelaide Brooke

quotes.name: Rogue's Passage
quotes.flavor: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

quotes.name: Angelic Page
quotes.flavor: If only every message were as perfect as its bearer.

quotes.name: Novablast Wurm
quotes.flavor:
"The sun was born within its coils, but it fled to the sky. The wurm hungers for its child, and the world will bear its loss."
—Screed of the Mul Daya

quotes.name: Seven of Nine
quotes.flavor: "I am no longer Borg, but the prospect of becoming human is . . . unsettling. I don't know where I belong."

quotes.name: Infuriate
quotes.flavor:
"No shirt, no shoes, no service."
—Marketplace sign

quotes.name: Minas Tirith
quotes.flavor:
"I would see the White Tree in flower again in the courts of the kings, and Minas Tirith in peace."
—Faramir

quotes.name: Crucible of Worlds
quotes.flavor: Amidst the darkest ashes grow the strongest seeds.

quotes.name: Gix's Caress
quotes.flavor: "Show me all the delicious misery you've sown."

quotes.name: Charge Through
quotes.flavor:
"What a move! Lorehold gets caught flat-footed, and Witherbloom barrels ahead."
—Cremik, Mage Tower commentator

quotes.name: Rain of Blades
quotes.flavor: Some say they are the weapons of heroes fallen in battle, eager for one last chance at glory.

quotes.name: Double Major
quotes.flavor: "Now I can dedicate myself fully to zoetimancy and void theory!"

quotes.name: Phantasmal Forces
quotes.flavor: These beings embody the essence of true heroes long dead. Summoned from the dreamrealms, they rise to meet their enemies.

quotes.name: Origin of Metalbending
quotes.flavor: Metal is just earth that has been purified and refined.

quotes.name: Fairgrounds Patrol
quotes.flavor: "No signs of any suspicious activity. Yet."

quotes.name: Might Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"The colossal thing rumbled over the ridge, tree husks crumbling before it. The ones we were already fighting howled as it came, their muscles suddenly surging, and we knew it was time to flee."
—Llanach, Skyshroud ranger

quotes.name: Volunteer Militia
quotes.flavor: People fight hardest on their own soil.

quotes.name: White Knight
quotes.flavor: Out of the blackness and stench of the engulfing swamp emerged a shimmering figure. Only the splattered armor and ichor-stained sword hinted at the unfathomable evil the knight had just laid waste.

quotes.name: Illegitimate Business
quotes.flavor: Their recipe isn't the only secret.

quotes.name: Trenching Steed
quotes.flavor: The Keldons took several of the steeds as trophies of war. They'd never seen such a light beast stand so firm.

quotes.name: Sram, Senior Edificer
quotes.flavor: "As this conflict grows, it gets harder to prevent the city from breaking down. How much longer can we keep this machinery balanced?"

quotes.name: Gutter Skulker // Gutter Shortcut
quotes.flavor: Some people take that as inspiration.

quotes.name: Uncage the Menagerie
quotes.flavor: The destruction of Rhonas's monument released his collection upon the city.

quotes.name: Gavony Unhallowed
quotes.flavor:
"We entered the church in search of solace, but it became clear we wouldn't find it there."
—Grete, Order of Saint Traft

quotes.name: Alphinaud Leveilleur
quotes.flavor: "We alone can accomplish little, but joined by others, we may yet build a bonfire to carry us heavensward."

quotes.name: Irrigated Farmland
quotes.flavor:
"Biodome Tunnel is out of bounds. Andy and Tarak are infected."
—Captain Adelaide Brooke

quotes.name: Edric, Spymaster of Trest
quotes.flavor: "I am not at liberty to reveal my sources, but I can assure you, the price on your head is high."

quotes.name: Journey for the Elixir
quotes.flavor: "As my hands touched it, I realized that I had not found it—it had been leading me here."

quotes.name: Viashino Sandstalker
quotes.flavor:
"Some believe Sandstalkers to be illusions; those with scars know better."
—*Zhalfirin Guide to the Desert*

quotes.name: Admiral Beckett Brass
quotes.flavor: "You and your ship will make a fine addition to my fleet."

quotes.name: Sadistic Augermage
quotes.flavor: "Don't worry. I know the drill."

quotes.name: Jungle Shrine
quotes.flavor: On Naya, ambition and treachery are scarce, hunted nearly to extinction by the awe owed to terrestrial gods.

quotes.name: Exotic Orchard
quotes.flavor:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

quotes.name: Stalking Drone
quotes.flavor: As the Eldrazi adapted to the jungles of Zendikar, some took on the tactics of more familiar predators.

quotes.name: Plague Myr
quotes.flavor: They watch for a new master, one more sinister than the last.

quotes.name: Serum Visions
quotes.flavor: "Why stop at the third eye?" came a whisper from the cup. "Drink more, and open them all."

quotes.name: Sorcerer's Strongbox
quotes.flavor: Simun the Quiet filled the chest with his most precious thoughts. But in a fit of paranoia, he locked up the memory of where he hid the key.

quotes.name: Meddle
quotes.flavor: Strength may win the fight, but style wins the crowd.

quotes.name: Flamewave Invoker
quotes.flavor: Inside even the humblest goblin lurks the potential for far greater things—and far worse.

quotes.name: Rakdos Charm
quotes.flavor:
"Let all feel joy in pain."
—Rakdos

quotes.name: Dubious Delicacy
quotes.flavor: It's an acquired taste.

quotes.name: Ogre Jailbreaker
quotes.flavor: It took three years for it to occur to him to use the chain as a weapon, but once it did, he made up for lost time.

quotes.name: Okiba Salvage
quotes.flavor: "Some fool would rather throw a whole mech away than repair one hydraulic actuator? It must be my lucky day."

quotes.name: Living Lies of Loki
quotes.flavor:
"Haha! My thickheaded brother, will you never learn?"
—Loki

quotes.name: Shock
quotes.flavor: If you're going to have a gimmick, embrace it.

quotes.name: Silent Sentinel
quotes.flavor: It serves a justice higher than the whims of the gods.

quotes.name: Lazotep Reaver
quotes.flavor: Despite their many forms, the Eternals worked in chilling harmony, unburdened by instinct or emotion.

quotes.name: For the Common Good
quotes.flavor: Despite their differences, every creature and culture of Valley stood in unison against the threat.

quotes.name: Crypt Rats
quotes.flavor:
"Once I dreamt of death, but now it dreams of me / And only rats and rotting flesh can hear my silent plea."
—Mundungu chant

quotes.name: Disdainful Stroke
quotes.flavor: "You are beneath contempt. Your lineage will be forgotten."

quotes.name: Lumengrid Gargoyle
quotes.flavor:
"Anything that watches without sleep and fights without fear is a valuable ally against the Phyrexians."
—Kara Vrist, Neurok agent

quotes.name: Shock
quotes.flavor:
Lightning tethers souls to the world.
—Kor saying

quotes.name: Shrieking Drake
quotes.flavor:
"Kaervek believes the drakes' cries herald his victory; in truth, they mourn aloud for his impending demise."
—Teferi

quotes.name: Yavimaya Ancients
quotes.flavor:
"We orphans of Fyndhorn have found no welcome in this alien place."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, elvish hunter

quotes.name: Dark Banishing
quotes.flavor:
"Ha, banishment? Be merciful, say 'death,'
For exile hath more terror in his look,
Much more than death."
—William Shakespeare, *Romeo and Juliet*

quotes.name: Monastery Swiftspear
quotes.flavor: The calligraphy of combat is written with strokes of sudden blood.

quotes.name: Slith Firewalker
quotes.flavor: The slith incubate in the Great Furnace's heat, emerging on Mirrodin's surface only when the four suns have aligned overhead.

quotes.name: Deeproot Waters
quotes.flavor: A visit to the Deeproot Tree and its ancient spring replenishes a merfolk's connection to nature.

quotes.name: Reya Dawnbringer
quotes.flavor: A beacon of hope for a battered army.

quotes.name: Strength of Will
quotes.flavor: And then—as the agonizing ache in his limbs seems unendurable—from out of the pain—from out of the agony—comes triumph!

quotes.name: Wheel of Torture
quotes.flavor: "I'd like to buy a bowel."

quotes.name: Tolarian Terror
quotes.flavor: Afterward, a number of treatises on sea serpent morphology were swiftly revised.

quotes.name: Devout Witness
quotes.flavor: The Cho-Arrim fought Mercadia's decadence with more than just swords.

quotes.name: Earthshaker Giant
quotes.flavor: "Come, my wild children. Let's give the interlopers a woodland welcome."

quotes.name: Mind Shatter
quotes.flavor: Dark thoughts hatch and twist within the mind, straining to take wing.

quotes.name: Alarum
quotes.flavor:
"One timely cry of warning can save nine of surprise."
—Sidar Jabari

quotes.name: Wall of Omens
quotes.flavor:
"I search for a vision of Zendikar that does not include the Eldrazi."
—Expedition journal entry

quotes.name: Darkslick Shores
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Promos
quotes.flavor: Where curiosity meets cruelty, hideous innovations arise.

quotes.name: Cyclopean Snare
quotes.flavor: The spoiled, gluttonous halls of the Orzhov teem with gaudy, needless wealth. Even their security measures are made for beauty first, efficiency second.

quotes.name: Desert Twister
quotes.flavor: Massive, mindless, and imbued with one terrible purpose.

quotes.name: Relearn
quotes.flavor: The hardest lessons to grasp are the ones you've already learned.

quotes.name: Leonin Arbiter
quotes.flavor: "Our people are torn by infighting. Until the two sides reconcile, our laws can carry no meaning."

quotes.name: Entrapment Maneuver
quotes.flavor: Every squad of deathclaw hunters had a role for the newbies: bait.

quotes.name: Soldevi Golem
quotes.flavor: Slow and steady wins the race.

quotes.name: Sanctum Prelate
quotes.flavor: "This area is off-limits to you."

quotes.name: Zagoth Triome
quotes.flavor: Hunters in the primeval wetlands become fluent in reading the ripples to tell when to pursue and when to flee.

quotes.name: Band Together
quotes.flavor: In times of peril, the vision the ancient paruns had for their city comes into focus.

quotes.name: Sumala Sentry
quotes.flavor: The great meditation garden of Sumala was no place for Ravnica's rising crime wave, and he would keep it that way.

quotes.name: Glory
quotes.flavor:
"Glory was gone; Glory was everywhere."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

quotes.name: Wakestone Gargoyle
quotes.flavor: Its pulsating cry shatters bonds of iron, granite, and servitude.

quotes.name: Unnatural Growth
quotes.flavor: With the cycles of day and night unspooled, the twisted sway of the moon only grew. And grew.

quotes.name: The Endstone
quotes.flavor: The future is set. The present remains uncertain.

quotes.name: Kujar Seedsculptor
quotes.flavor: Every leaf, tree, and building in Kujar has been placed to achieve maximum harmony, in accordance with the elvish philosophy known as the Great Conduit.

quotes.name: Kwain, Itinerant Meddler
quotes.flavor: "Why so slow, why so slow? Hurry up! You never know what you'll find."

quotes.name: Serpent Warrior
quotes.flavor: They're the fiercest of all the Western Paladin's soldiers. They're also the most fiercely loyal—but that loyalty comes at a price.

quotes.name: Falter
quotes.flavor: Like a sleeping dragon, Shiv stirs and groans at times.

quotes.name: Fell the Mighty
quotes.flavor:
"There we sat high up above the floods and watched the drowning of Isengard."
—Pippin

quotes.name: Flow of Ideas
quotes.flavor:
"Beware the merrows, whose envy and covetousness surpasses even that of the ravenous whirlpools where they dwell."
—*The Book of Other Folk*

quotes.name: Shoreline Salvager
quotes.flavor:
"They search for treasures that wash up from the depths. Tracking one could lead you to riches. Or in circles."
—Javad Nasrin, Ondu relic hunter

quotes.name: Orzhov Guildgate
quotes.flavor:
"So much wealth. So much splendor. So much temptation to believe the gilded lie."
—Kaya

quotes.name: Elvenking's Harper
quotes.flavor:
"Hundreds of torches and many fires must have been lit suddenly and by magic. And hark to the singing and the harps!"
—Kíli

quotes.name: Inspired Charge
quotes.flavor:
"For the lands you have lost and the beauty that remains, for freedom and the future, we must hold nothing back!"
—Gideon Jura

quotes.name: Fell the Mighty
quotes.flavor:
"They had it coming."
—Squire Imalia, savior of Thiswick

quotes.name: Floral Evoker
quotes.flavor: "Death is a natural thing. It replenishes the land's energy and nourishes the growth of all life."

quotes.name: Tragic Arrogance
quotes.flavor: The spear thrown by Kytheon's own hand was the weapon that felled his friends.

quotes.name: Flawless Maneuver
quotes.flavor:
"Captain, your units are the tip of our spear. There is zero room for failure."
—Jirina Kudro

quotes.name: Fountain of Youth
quotes.flavor: The Fountain had stood in the town square for centuries, but only the pigeons knew its secret.

quotes.name: Mesa Pegasus
quotes.flavor: Before a woman marries in the village of Sursi, she must visit the land of the Mesa Pegasus. Legend has it that if the woman is pure of heart and her love is true, a Mesa Pegasus will appear, blessing her family with long life and good fortune.

quotes.name: Sacred Excavation
quotes.flavor: The anointed work the mines without pause, their cartouches instilling them with tireless purpose.

quotes.name: Nightpack Ambusher
quotes.flavor: A strong leader means a growing pack.

quotes.name: Nature's Will
quotes.flavor: The frogs' friendship wasn't necessary for survival, but it did come with generous servings of strawberry crumble.

quotes.name: Fall of the Hammer
quotes.flavor: It is unwise to insult the god of the forge. It is also unwise to stand near anyone else who has insulted him.

quotes.name: Kessig Cagebreakers
quotes.flavor: "They put bars on these noble beasts and then wonder why werewolves target our towns."

quotes.name: Lavinia, Azorius Renegade
quotes.flavor: "I told Jace that Ravnica would fall apart if he didn't take his responsibilities seriously. I didn't want to be right."

quotes.name: Liliana's Specter
quotes.flavor:
"The finest minions know what I need without me ever saying a thing."
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Sunken Hope
quotes.flavor:
"I don't concern myself with my enemy's hopes. Hopes follow the tides. They will retreat soon enough."
—Ambassador Laquatus

quotes.name: Suspicious Bookcase
quotes.flavor: The great library in the Museum of Old Capenna has a million volumes on display—and miles of passages hidden behind them.

quotes.name: Insight
quotes.flavor:
"We can fight with you or against you. After my day, I'd prefer the former."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

quotes.name: Anticipate
quotes.flavor: "You thought I wouldn't see that coming?"

quotes.name: Hunter's Insight
quotes.flavor:
"The predator knows the true way of the world. Life is conflict. Only the strong survive."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

quotes.name: Ponder
quotes.flavor: Tomorrow belongs to those who prepare for it today.

quotes.name: Ambitious Aetherborn
quotes.flavor: Aetherborn who are unwilling to accept the decomposition of their bodies invent ways to preserve and augment themselves.

quotes.name: Battle-Rattle Shaman
quotes.flavor: The shaman rattles not to inspire a battle fury but to drown out the shrieks of those fleeing the Eldrazi.

quotes.name: Valakut Predator
quotes.flavor:
"Whatever volcanoes dream of, it seems like they always wake up grumpy."
—Raff Slugeater, goblin shortcutter

quotes.name: Fyndhorn Elves
quotes.flavor: "We could no more abandon the forest than the stars could abandon the night sky."

quotes.name: Weather the Storm
quotes.flavor: "Quell your ego and anywhere can be as calm as a hurricane's eye."

quotes.name: Where Ancients Tread
quotes.flavor:
"Never subtle nor cryptic is the reckoning of the mighty."
—Mayael the Anima

quotes.name: Hate Weaver
quotes.flavor: "Let my hate fuel your fury."

quotes.name: Sword Dancer
quotes.flavor: Most soldiers think of the sword as a weapon. In the hands of Zho monks, swords are also the strongest of shields.

quotes.name: Jack-o'-Lantern
quotes.flavor: By the end of the festival, it was the only thing still grinning.

quotes.name: Pact of the Serpent
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor: "Our quarrels behind us. Our foes before us. Death or triumph for us all!"

quotes.name: Undergrowth Recon
quotes.flavor:
"I want eyes on the scene of the crime, day and night. I have a feeling our killer won't be able to resist coming back."
—Thare of the Foundway Associates

quotes.name: Divination
quotes.flavor: "The stars mark your destiny. May you accept the fate thus divulged."

quotes.name: Rhystic Study
quotes.flavor:
"I believe I've discovered something truly incredible: a way to harness magic through science!"
—Jayce Talis

quotes.name: Sling-Gang Lieutenant
quotes.flavor: Freshly promoted to "first rock," Zaz was eager to make an impact.

quotes.name: Jokulhaups
quotes.flavor:
"The raging waters had swept away trees, bridges, and even houses. My healers had much work to do."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran priest

quotes.name: Soltari Trooper
quotes.flavor:
"Dauthi blood is Soltari wine."
—Soltari Tales of Life

quotes.name: Desolation
quotes.flavor:
"Kill a creature, destroy the present. Kill the land, destroy the future."
—Kaervek

quotes.name: Envelop
quotes.flavor:
"What you made will be unmade. What you learned will be unlearned. And when you're done, you will be undone."
—Ambassador Laquatus

quotes.name: Goliath Sphinx
quotes.flavor: He makes his home on the tallest mountain in Sejiri, where the vista is as endless as his patience.

quotes.name: Diregraf Ghoul
quotes.flavor:
"At least this one still has arms and legs. Well, most of its legs."
—Enslow, ghoulcaller of Nephalia

quotes.name: Hollow One
quotes.flavor: The embodiment of yearning, forever drifting the deserts to find what had once made it whole.

quotes.name: Primevals' Glorious Rebirth
quotes.flavor: Centuries ago, five dragons conquered death to rule the living.

quotes.name: Akroma, Angel of Wrath
quotes.flavor: "No rest. No mercy. No matter what."

quotes.name: Hand of Death
quotes.flavor: The touch of death is never gentle.

quotes.name: Rare-B-Gone
quotes.flavor: The only rare you'll ever need. Okay, not really.

quotes.name: Dark Confidant
quotes.flavor: Greatness, at any cost.

quotes.name: Darkwater Catacombs
quotes.flavor: Murky Otarian tides hide the forgotten treacheries of the Phyrexian war.

quotes.name: Cemetery Puca
quotes.flavor:
"'Tis a strange creature indeed that chooses the vanquished over the victor."
—Awylla, elvish safewright

quotes.name: Orzhov Advokist
quotes.flavor: The Orzhov care not for repentance, only repayment.

quotes.name: Broadcast Rambler
quotes.flavor: Get the shot. Every time.

quotes.name: Primeval Titan
quotes.flavor: When nature calls, *run*.

quotes.name: Gonti's Machinations
quotes.flavor: "I am confident that all our enterprises can benefit from this little revolution."

quotes.name: Clever Impersonator
quotes.flavor:
"Our own selves are the greatest obstacles to enlightenment."
—Narset, khan of the Jeskai

quotes.name: Spelltithe Enforcer
quotes.flavor: His assistants calculate the amount of the tribute. He measures out the punishment for delinquency.

quotes.name: Evasive Action
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Phyrexia vs. the Coalition
quotes.flavor: Effective use of terrain is a lesson good commanders learn quickly.

quotes.name: Bladed Pinions
quotes.flavor: Lacking trained pterons, the Auriok had to rely on other measures to gain the upper hand in the skies.

quotes.name: Lord of Extinction
quotes.flavor: The forlorn cries of the dead combine to make its laugh.

quotes.name: Enchanted Evening
quotes.flavor: In the reflection, she saw the rough shell of the world sloughing away, revealing the truth shining underneath.

quotes.name: Command Tower
quotes.flavor:
"The servers are the seven Chaos. power enriched by Chaos is power the heart. The controller is the one that unifies the Chaos."
—Tikal's prayer

quotes.name: Balduvian Barbarians
quotes.flavor:
"From the snowy slopes of Kaelor,
To the canyons of Bandu,
We drink and fight and feast and die
As we were born to do."
—Balduvian tavern song

quotes.name: Double Cleave
quotes.flavor: "When in doubt, kill 'em twice."

quotes.name: Auriok Salvagers
quotes.flavor: "Memnarch or the vedalken salvage most of the large machines, leaving us only scraps. Scraps are enough."

quotes.name: Balduvian Bears
quotes.flavor:
"They're a hardy bunch, but I'd still bet that they just slept through the worst of the cold times."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

quotes.name: Evra, Halcyon Witness
quotes.flavor:
"Light from the Null Moon took form—a mirage made real, alone in grandeur, isolated in a world that once had been its own."
—*Fall of the Thran*

quotes.name: Leatherback Baloth
quotes.flavor: Heavy enough to withstand the Roil, leatherback skeletons are havens for travelers in storms and landshifts.

quotes.name: Network Terminal
quotes.flavor: Public access terminals around Towashi provide residents with up-to-date information on everything from traffic delays to hostile kami sightings.

quotes.name: Baleful Strix
quotes.flavor: Its beak rends flesh and bone, exposing the tender marrow of dream.

quotes.name: Loxodon Punisher
quotes.flavor: The loxodons believe punishment comes in two steps: pain and atonement. They carry a weapon for each.

quotes.name: Infiltration Lens
quotes.flavor: Neurok spies carry devices that let them look a few moments into the future, giving them an almost insurmountable edge.

quotes.name: Illusory Angel
quotes.flavor:
"In a daze, I woke and looked upon the battlefield, where I could swear my dreams were laying waste to the enemy."
—Letter from a soldier

quotes.name: Skyseer's Chariot
quotes.flavor: "It's the dawn of a new era, and we shall rise like the suns to greet it."

quotes.name: Void Rend
quotes.flavor:
"I expect some voidsent are more intelligent than others. Perhaps these ones simply do not understand our words."
—Y'shtola Rhul

quotes.name: Tomik, Distinguished Advokist
quotes.flavor: "Some bend the law. I tie it into knots."

quotes.name: Mind Ravel
quotes.flavor: An end to reason, an end to order. Forget all that has been.

quotes.name: Wasteland
quotes.flavor:
"But I am going to Mordor," said Frodo.
"I know that well enough," said Sam. "Of course you are. And I'm coming with you."

quotes.name: Avian Changeling
quotes.flavor: Today it flies with the flock. Tomorrow it may wake to find them gone, its body in an unfamiliar form.

quotes.name: Goldenglow Moth
quotes.flavor: Ordinary moths follow it, drawn to its light.

quotes.name: Affectionate Indrik
quotes.flavor: The problem isn't the indrik's enthusiasm, it's Ravnica's lack of guardrails.

quotes.name: Boros Signet
quotes.flavor:
"Have you ever held a Boros signet? There's a weight to it that belies its size—a weight of strength and of pride."
—Agrus Kos

quotes.name: Reya Dawnbringer
quotes.flavor: "You have not died until I consent."

quotes.name: Retromancer
quotes.flavor: "If one harm us, strike them in return. So sayeth the bey."

quotes.name: Nyxborn Seaguard
quotes.flavor:
"Storm-tossed and broken, Callaphe cried out to deep-dwelling Thassa.
Tritons came swiftly to save her, bringing her north to the Lindus."
—*The Callapheia*

quotes.name: Axgard Artisan
quotes.flavor: Skodreg knew the Phyrexians wouldn't appreciate his craftsmanship, but they'd get an up-close look just the same.

quotes.name: Purple Pentapus
quotes.flavor: Useful for whipping up a fictional plague in a pinch.

quotes.name: Tarfire
quotes.flavor:
"After Auntie brushed the soot from her eyes, she discovered something wonderful: the fire had turned the goat into something that smelled delicious."
—A tale of Auntie Grub

quotes.name: Obscuring Haze
quotes.flavor: Whether hunter or hunted, Kathril chooses when it is seen.

quotes.name: Hand of Death
quotes.flavor: Death claims all but the darkest souls.

quotes.name: Towering Viewpoint
quotes.flavor: The leap of faith is a sacred rite of the Assassins—it strengthens their resolve and purges fear from their hearts.

quotes.name: Seer's Sundial
quotes.flavor: "The shadow travels toward the apex. I predict we will soon see the true measure of darkness."

quotes.name: Hawkeye, Clint Barton
quotes.flavor: "What can you do with arrows? A whole lot."

quotes.name: Chaos Warp
quotes.flavor: Their lives stretched before them, each more magnificent than the last.

quotes.name: Maelstrom Pulse
quotes.flavor: During the collision of the shards, entire ways of life disappeared without a trace.

quotes.name: Hurloon Minotaur
quotes.flavor: The Minotaurs of the Hurloon Mountains are known for their love of battle. They are also known for their hymns to the dead, sung for friend and foe alike. These hymns can last for days, filling the mountain valleys with their low, haunting sounds.

quotes.name: Orcish Lumberjack
quotes.flavor:
"How did I ever let myself get talked into this project?"
—Toothlicker Harj, orcish captain

quotes.name: Sootstoke Kindler
quotes.flavor: "Nothing warms my heart better than a spirit kindled with rage."

quotes.name: Treasonous Ogre
quotes.flavor: The ogre was right, the view was breathtaking—mostly due to all the screaming on the way down.

note: Real flavor texts from the MTGJSON card corpus. Unfiltered view is a daily-stable random sample; search to reach the full corpus.
